quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.0: There you are, %s! Welcome to Sniffville. Everybody here lives on four paws, nyeg. I'm Wendy Wagtail: I comb the beach and find all sorts of things. Today I found you!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.1: You came rolling out of the sea like a wet sock. Don't worry: being a dog now is just part of the island. At home you're simply yourself again, and all your things are safe there, waiting for you.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.welkom.2: But first, off to Doctor Plasterpaw. His office is the white house with the red cross, right by the square. Just tell him everything. Go on, tail up!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.dag.0: Found anything nice yet? Today I found three shells, a boot and a dog. The dog was you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.redder.klaar.0: A trace of your father, I heard already! If I find anything of his on the beach, I'll keep it for you. Beachcomber's honor.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.0: Well well, a washed-up pup. Let's see... nose wet, tail in one piece, four paws. Fit as a fiddle! But you look so worried, %s. Go on, tell the doctor.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.1: Your little brother or sister is sick... and your father has been gone for weeks, looking for the healing flower? Hm. Yes. That flower is real. It grows here, deep on Sniff Island.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.2: But you can't SEE it, only SMELL it. Only a real sniff nose can find it. And your nose... well. That's still a human nose in a dog's snout, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.verhaal.3: Go to Master Trufflenose, in the meadow behind the little gate on the north side of the square. He turns every pup into a sniffer. Just say Plasterpaw sent you. And wipe your paws!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.dag.0: Nose wet, tail up: then everything turns out fine. Doctor's orders! And sniff something new every day.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.dokter.klaar.0: A scarf of your father's, by the little tree! Then he really was here. Rest up well, little sniff pup. The trail isn't going anywhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.eerst_dok: Hmm... you smell of seawater and questions. Go see Doctor Plasterpaw in the village first. After that, we talk.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.0: Aha, %s. Plasterpaw sent you. I am Master Trufflenose, and I smelled you coming when you were still lying on the beach. You will learn that too.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.1: Lesson one: HOLD THE SNIFF KEY. Your nose goes to the ground and the scent meter appears on your screen. The closer you are to the scent, the harder it swings.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.2: The color tells you what you smell. Orange is something tasty. I have buried a chew bone close by. Swinging all the way? Then you are standing on it, and then you DIG.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1.3: Digging is simple: just hold down your left mouse button. You are a dog now, so you do not break the block: you dig! Keep holding until the chew bone comes up. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les1_hint: Nose down, tail up! Hold the sniff key and walk to where the orange meter swings hardest. The chew bone is close by, in the grass. Standing on it? Then just hold down your left mouse button: as a dog you do not break the block, you dig!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2.0: A chew bone, and not even eaten. Well done! That was orange: something tasty. Lesson two: BLUE. Blue is a thing.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2.1: My whistle is missing. It is somewhere farther off in the meadow, toward the hedge. The farther away, the fainter the scent: simply walk the way the meter grows. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les2_hint: My whistle is farther off, on the west side of the meadow, by the hedge. Walk with your nose to the ground until the blue meter grows. Swinging all the way: dig!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3.0: My whistle! Fweet... hm, there is sand in it. Thank you. Lesson three: GREEN. Green is an animal. And not everything lies under the ground: some scents hang somewhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3.1: Bees live in the big oak on the west side of the meadow. Stand close to it and keep sniffing until you have caught the scent. No digging, no nipping. Bees nip back, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.les3_hint: The bees live in the big oak on the west side of the meadow. Stand close to it and hold the sniff key until your nose knows. No need to dig.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.lessen_kl: Tasty things, things, animals: three colors in your sniff book, %s. The fourth color is purple: something strange. That one I cannot teach you. You will smell it by yourself, one day.
Do you hear that? Rattling and barking, on the square! Things have been falling over there all week and nobody sees who is doing it. You go and have a look, with that fresh nose of yours.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.kabaal.0: That racket is coming from the square. Go have a look by the well, pup. I am staying here: my ears are too long for running.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.daden.0: Real sniffers help the village. You have done %s of the %s good deeds. Is your buddy's little tree a young tree? Then you come back for your exam.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.0: The little tree is pretty as a picture, %s. Time for the SNIFFING EXAM! There's no such thing as failing: your nose may take as long as it likes.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.1: I have hidden four scents in the meadow and the village. One of each color: something tasty, a thing, an animal and... something strange. Two are buried, two hang somewhere.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen.2: On your screen you can see how many you have. Got all four? Then come back for your diploma. Nose down, tail up. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.examen_hi: You have %s of the %s. Something tasty lies in the meadow, my spare cap by the meadow gate, the animal lives in Gardener Turnip's vegetable patch and the strange thing stands right by the roadblock. Seek!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.0: All four! And not a single one eaten! Sit. No, stay standing, you are wagging too hard. Ahem.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.1: I, Master Trufflenose, hereby declare that %1$s has passed the sniffing exam. From now on you are officially: %2$s. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.diploma.2: There are five ranks. Sniff Nose, the second, you become at twenty scents: then you may pass the roadblock. But that is for later. Hey... your buddy is fluttering so. I believe it wants to show you something by the little tree.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.boom.0: Your buddy wants to show you something by the little tree, on the little hill. Go have a look. And bring your nose.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.trainer.klaar.0: A trace of your father, beyond the roadblock... You may only pass there as a Sniff Nose, rank two of five. Keep sniffing, pup. Every new scent counts, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.hallo.0: Fresh bread! Well, almost. Without a rolling pin it's more of a ball. Come back later, pup, I'm busy grumbling.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.vraag.0: My rolling pin is gone! Yesterday it was still on the windowsill, this morning: poof. Without a rolling pin all I can bake is rolls. The whole village has been eating rolls for three days!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.vraag.1: You've had sniffing lessons, haven't you? It smells of dough: something tasty, so orange. Find it for me and I'll bake flat loaves again. Wahoog!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.hint.0: My rolling pin smells of fresh dough. Last night I heard something rolling, past the little school, toward the fisherman's hut. Somewhere in the grass there, I think. Nose down!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.terug.0: My rolling pin! And there's still dough on it! Flat bread again at last. Always a crust for you, pup. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.bakker.dank.0: Flat bread, flat cookies, flat everything. Thanks to you! Want a crust? Oh no, wait. Eaten. Sorry.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.hallo.0: Shh. The fish are sleeping. Or I am. One of the two. Come back later, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.vraag.0: My favorite bobber is gone. Red and white. Without a bobber I can't tell if I've got a bite. I've been sitting here since Tuesday. It is still Tuesday, isn't it?
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.vraag.1: It smells of fish. Everything of mine smells of fish. That's green on your meter: an animal. Will you look for it? Then I'll catch a fish for you. If I get a bite.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.hint.0: My bobber drifted off with the tide, to the little beach south of the harbor. Just follow the coast with your nose. It smells of fish, same as me.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.terug.0: My bobber! Red, white and still wet. Now I can tell again when I've got a bite. Hey... I've got a bite! Oh no. Seaweed.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.visser.dank.0: Bobber bobs, fisher fishes. As it should be. Thank you, pup. Shh, don't wag so hard, you'll startle the fish.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.hallo.0: Good morning! Or is it afternoon already? Without the school bell nobody knows what time it is. Come back later, pup. Once I know when later is.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.vraag.0: The school bell is gone! Now class never starts, and it never ends either. The pups have been at recess since Monday. They think it's wonderful. I don't.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.vraag.1: A bell is a thing, so blue on your meter. It smells of copper and chalk. Will you look for it? Then you get an A for sniffing.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.hint.0: In the night I heard jingling in the meadow, all the way at the back by the pond. The bell smells of copper and chalk. Blue on your meter!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.terug.0: DING-A-LING! Oh, how I've missed that. Recess is over, pups! ...They've already run off. An A with a gold star for you.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.juf.dank.0: Ding-a-ling! Class starts on time again. The pups like that less than I do, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.hallo.0: Hello, dearie. My, how thin you are. Do you even have a scarf? Come back later and I'll knit you one. If I can find my wool.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.vraag.0: My ball of wool has rolled away, dearie. The lilac one. I was working on a sweater for the captain. It has one sleeve now. It looks so odd.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.vraag.1: Wool smells of sheep, so green on your meter. If you find it, I'll knit something for you too. Four little socks. One for each paw.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.hint.0: It rolled out the door, through the beach gate, all the way to the sand on the west side of the beach. Wool smells of sheep, dearie. Green!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.terug.0: My lilac ball! Full of sand, but I'll beat that right out. Now the captain gets his second sleeve. And you get four little socks. Nyeg, dearie.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.oma.dank.0: The captain's sweater is finished. It has three sleeves by accident. But it's the thought that counts, dearie.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.hallo.0: Don't stand on the carrots! And no digging in my vegetable patch. Digging is for outside the fence. Come back later, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.vraag.0: My little watering can is gone! My turnips are thirsty. I'm watering them with my hat now, but it leaks. And then I've got a wet head.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.vraag.1: A watering can is a thing: blue. It smells of rainwater and a little of turnip. Can you find it? Then you get the biggest carrot in the garden. To look at.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.hint.0: I last had it in the meadow, on the east side, where I pick clover. Blue on your meter, and it smells of rainwater.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.terug.0: My little watering can! Come along, little turnips, drink up! And for you: the biggest carrot in the garden. No, don't dig it up. Look.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.tuinder.dank.0: The turnips are growing like weeds. And the weeds are growing like weeds too. Thanks to you and my little watering can, pup.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.hallo.0: Yip! Yip yip! Play? I have a ball! Oh no. I HAD a ball. Yip...
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.vraag.0: Yip! My bouncy ball is gone! It bounced and bounced and then it was GONE. I looked everywhere. Well, here. I looked here.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.vraag.1: It's red and it's covered in drool. Mine! Will you find it? Will you find it? Will you find it? Yip!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.hint.0: It bounced out the beach gate, to the beach! I'm not allowed to go there alone. It's covered in drool, so you'll smell it right away. Yip!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.pup.terug.0: MY BALL! Yip yip yip! You're the best dog on the whole island! After me. Play? Play!
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.kapitein.vraag.0: Ahoy, landlubber! My little boat is ready. Shall I sail you back home? You'll end up exactly where you came from, with all your things. The island isn't going anywhere, and neither is your nose, nyeg.
quest.guhs.snuffeldorp.kapitein.vraag_kl: Ahoy, sniff pup! Sailing home? With your Guhstation you can come back whenever you like. Can't find that little box? Just say so, I've got a few more in the hold.
Captain Saltsnout slides a new Guhstation over to you. It goes home with you, nyeg.
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.golven: Waves. Sand in your ears. And something wet sniffing at your snout...
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.hallo: Sniff sniff... Hey! You're okay! Nyeg, you're so wet.
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.wakker: Wake up, sleepyhead! You've washed ashore on Sniff Island.
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.pootjes: Wait a minute... pawsies?! A tail?! You're a DOG!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_wakker.kom: I'm Wendy Wagtail. Come along to the village, a doctor lives there!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.kef: Yip! The bucket! It's moving by itself!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.alweer: Again! Who keeps DOING that? I don't see anybody, nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.alleen_jij: There, above the well... does nobody see that?
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.zien: Hee hee... wait. You're looking at me. Can you SEE me?!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_maatje.blijf: Nobody ever sees me! I'm staying with you. Nyeg!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_spoor.sjaal: A scarf. Blue with stripes. It smells of... PAPA!
scene.guhs.snuffeldorp_spoor.spoor: Papa was here! His trail leads up the island, past the roadblock.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.les_gevonden: Found it! Go back to Master Trufflenose
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.breng_terug: Found it! Bring it back to %s
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.examen_klaar: All four scents found! Go back to Master Trufflenose for your diploma. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.daden_klaar: Your buddy's little tree is a young tree! Master Trufflenose is waiting for you in the meadow: time for your exam.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.versperring: You may only pass here as a Sniff Nose
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.zee: Nyeg, the sea is far too wild for doggy paws! The waves put you back on dry land
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.wakker.1: You're a dog on Sniff Island! Walk down the path to the village: Wendy Wagtail is waiting by the beach gate.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.wakker.2: Your own things are safe at home. With the memory card in your hotbar you can always go back home.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.maatje.1: %s: Hee hee! That bucket, that was me. And the rolling pin. And the school bell. And... well. I like hiding things. Sorry, nyeg.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.maatje.2: %s: Shall we bring everything back together? With every good deed my little tree in the meadow grows! When you sniff, I'll point the way.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.bloesem.1: %s: Look! My little tree is blooming, thanks to you. This blossom twig is for you. It goes home with you.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.bloesem.2: %s: Hey... do you smell that too? Between the stones by the little tree. Something strange. Have a sniff!
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.1: A trace of Papa! It leads farther up the island, past the roadblock. You may only pass there as a Sniff Nose.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.2: %s: Oh yes, this was in my hiding spot too. A gray-black little box with a guh snoot on it: a Guhstation! Put it down at home and you'll be back with me in no time.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.einde.3: The first story of Sniff Island is done. You're a real Sniff Pup! To be continued, nyeg.
gui.guhs.snuffeldorp.doel.terug: A dock cottage (the boat to Sniff Island)
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_neus.de: Your first scent! Hold the &fsniff key&r and walk to where the &fscent meter&r swings hardest. Orange is something tasty, blue a thing, green an animal and purple something strange. Everything your nose learns is in your &fsniff book&r.
The naughty &aforest sprite&r has hidden half the household of Sniffville. Now that you can see it, it wants to make everything right: it points the way when you smell something, and with every good deed its little tree grows.
&6Baker Crumbsnout&r can't find his rolling pin and has been baking nothing but rolls for days. Ask him about it, sniff out the rolling pin (orange: something tasty) and bring it back.
To Bite or Not to Bite?
&6Fisher Wetnose&r is missing his favorite bobber. It drifted off with the tide. Sniff along the coast south of the harbor (green: it smells of fish).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_juf.des: Without the school bell recess is never over. &6Miss Barkley&r likes that less than the pups do. Look for the bell at the back of the meadow (blue: a thing).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_oma.des: The lilac ball of wool of &6Granny Woolly&r has rolled away, through the beach gate. Sniff in the sand on the west side of the beach (green: wool smells of sheep).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_tuinder: &6Gardener Turnip&r waters his turnips with his hat, and it leaks. His little watering can is somewhere on the east side of the meadow (blue: a thing).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_pup.des: The bouncy ball of &6Little Droolball&r bounced out the beach gate. It's covered in drool, so you'll smell it right away (blue: a thing).
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_boom.de: Four good deeds: your buddy's little tree has grown from a &asprout&r through a &ashoot&r and a &alittle bush&r into a &ayoung tree&r. At every step you see it grow, high above the village. Master Trufflenose now thinks you're ready for the exam.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_alle.de: All six villagers have their things back. It's quiet again in Sniffville. Well: the school bell rings, the pup bounces and the baker sings. Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_diploma: Passed Master Trufflenose's sniffing exam: four hidden scents, one of each color. You are officially a &6Sniff Pup&r, rank 1 (the lowest) of 5 (the highest). The other ranks come in a later story.
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_versper: You May Only Pass Here as a Sniff Nose

Behind the meadow the road goes on, up the island: a forest, a hill with standing stones, a lighthouse. But there is a friendly &croadblock&r. A Sniff Pup can't get past it, not even swimming. To be continued!
ftb.guhs_verhalen.q.snuffel_dorp_guhstat: Your buddy still had something in its hiding spot: a &8Guhstation&r. Put it down at home, click it and press start: you're back on the island, at the spot where you were. Can't find it? &6Captain Saltsnout&r in the harbor has a few more.
